description: This file defines a metrics package for monitoring focalboard server components using Prometheus. It includes metric definitions, initialization, and update methods for tracking server and application metrics.

classes.name: InstanceInfo
classes.description: Holds version, build number, edition, and installation ID info for a focalboard instance.

classes.name: Metrics
classes.description: Encapsulates Prometheus metrics and registry for monitoring focalboard server activities.

methods.name: NewMetrics
methods.description: Factory function to create and initialize a Metrics object with Prometheus metrics and registry.

methods.name: IncrementLoginCount
methods.description: Increments the login count metric by a specified number.

methods.name: IncrementLogoutCount
methods.description: Increments the logout count metric by a specified number.

methods.name: IncrementLoginFailCount
methods.description: Increments the failed login count metric by a specified number.

methods.name: IncrementBlocksInserted
methods.description: Increments the count of inserted blocks and updates last activity time.

methods.name: IncrementBlocksPatched
methods.description: Increments the count of patched blocks and updates last activity time.

methods.name: IncrementBlocksDeleted
methods.description: Increments the count of deleted blocks and updates last activity time.

methods.name: ObserveBlockCount
methods.description: Sets the gauge for the total count of a specific block type.

methods.name: ObserveBoardCount
methods.description: Sets the gauge for the total number of boards.

methods.name: ObserveTeamCount
methods.description: Sets the gauge for the total number of teams.
